paper_title: Exotic energy injection in the early universe II: CMB spectral distortions and constraints on light dark matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (estimated from decay-lifetime constraint tau~1e25 s via Gamma=g^2 m_a^3/64pi)
notes: Paper recasts CMB anisotropy (Planck 2015-based) constraints on decaying DM (chi->gamma gamma) into a bound on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (Fig. 10, 'CMB anisotropy our work'). Constraint applies for ALP mass from ~2R=27.2 eV up to ~10 keV. The plotted curve is derived from the minimum-lifetime constraint (Fig. 9, tau ~ 1e25 s). Data points here are ESTIMATED by converting the approximate lifetime bound to g_agamma using Gamma = g^2 m_a^3/(64pi); exact plot digitization not available, so values approximate. This is a cosmological (not haloscope) bound, so no local DM density applies. Not a projection - based on existing Planck data (though PIXIE-related spectral-distortion parts are projections, the g_agamma limit itself is an observed constraint). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.45, 7))
